title: The Paycheck Gap
subtitle: How to Turn Your Savings Into a Retirement Paycheck You Can Count On
author: Jordan Ellis

back.headline: You saved for thirty years. Nobody showed you how to turn it into a paycheck.
blurb: Most good savers reach retirement with a number, not a plan. The space between the two has a name: the Paycheck Gap. In this short, practical book, retirement income planner Jordan Ellis shows you how to see your own gap on one page, and what to do about it.
bullets: Why a big savings number isn't the same as a retirement paycheck
The three risks that can quietly shrink your income
The five steps of the Retirement Paycheck Blueprint
A worksheet in every chapter, with printable copies online
back.bio: Jordan Ellis is a fictional retirement income planner used to demonstrate this template.
